credits.name: Tesseract.js 7.0.0
credits.note: Unmodified dist files. The worker bundle includes regenerator-runtime (MIT), zlib.js (MIT), idb-keyval (Apache-2.0), bmp-js (MIT), is-url (MIT), wasm-feature-detect (Apache-2.0), buffer (MIT) and ieee754 (BSD-3-Clause); their licence texts are in /vendor/licenses/.

credits.name: tesseract.js-core 7.0.0
credits.note: The Tesseract OCR engine compiled to WebAssembly, unmodified. Only the three text-recognition (LSTM) builds are served; your browser loads just one of them.

credits.name: Tesseract OCR (Balearica fork used by tesseract.js-core)

Licence texts: /vendor/licenses/leptonica.LICENSE, libjpeg.LICENSE, libpng.LICENSE, libtiff.LICENSE, libwebp.LICENSE, giflib.LICENSE, zlib.LICENSE, openlibm.LICENSE.
